about_the_game:
Overview

This is a game where you identify dangers (near-miss situations) in various locations.

You have been appointed as the Chairperson of the Safety and Health Committee at your workplace.

Believing that people only realize the true value of safety after losing it, you decide to use digital twin technology to create a virtual world where avatars engage in risky behaviors and simulate potential hazards.

Contents

  • Collect manuals that contain the rules and safety guidelines for each location.

  • When you find an avatar engaging in dangerous behavior or breaking the rules, confront them by showing the manual.

  • If the avatar is no longer in a dangerous situation—or if they are acting safely—confirm with a cheerful "Safety Confirmed! (Yoshi!)"

  • Remember, the job isn't finished until you safely return. There is also a time limit, so once you've done a good job, head to the goal and finish your workday.

※ The images shown are from a development version and may change.
